item.title: Tsuruga Old Town: A Historic Port With a Railway and Maritime Legacy — Guide
item.description: Tsuruga is a historic port town on the Sea of Japan coast of southern Fukui, blending several strands of history, from the grand Kehi Jingu, one of the region’s most important Shinto shrines with a towering wooden torii gate, to a rich railway and maritime past that once made Tsuruga a gateway for international rail and ferry connections linking Japan with the Asian continent and beyond. The old town area preserves this layered heritage, with museums and historic streetscapes recalling its era as a bustling international port.
